about: Where each barn's pin goes on its page's fly-over (2026-10-24; Scott: the pin on the street in front of the barn "is quite acceptable"). "address": the barn's premises address from USDA APHIS's list of Federally Approved Livestock Markets (public domain), placed by the US Census Geocoder, so it sits on the road in front. "checked": dragged onto the barn on the aerial photo by Scott. A barn missing here (its address didn't match) gets no pin and no fly-over until someone places it.
source: USDA APHIS, Federally Approved Livestock Markets, https://www.aphis.usda.gov/livestock-poultry-disease/traceability/approved-livestock-markets; US Census Geocoder, https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/
